Thanks for looping me in — quick finance ops notes: 

- We can support multiple invoice lanes; our billing system tags invoices with metadata fields that map to CSV exports for ERP ingestion. We will need the PO number to be present on every invoice line.
- ProjectCode mapping: acceptable format for automated ingestion is 6-12 alphanumeric characters, no spaces; prefix like HB- is OK.
- Net60 requests: we treat extended terms as a credit extension and normally require either (a) a short credit check or (b) an early-pay discount. For an annual committed contract we can do Net60 with a 2.5% discount, conditional on: signed SOW, one-time onboarding fee paid on receipt of first invoice, and a DocuSign authorization that confirms the billing cadence.

Irene — I recommend we propose the Net60 + 2.5% discount to HealthBridge but call out the three gating items above. Vanessa, any commercial objections?
